DevicesMFE.py.summary: DevicesMFE is a page class that extends SmartFlow and provides automation methods for interacting with the Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) interface. It includes verification flows to check the presence and state of various UI elements such as popups, navigation bars, device cards, and panels. The class also provides action flows for user interactions including clicking buttons, refreshing the page, and retrieving text content from popup screens. Special functionality includes handling the HPX What's New popup with multiple screens, managing device cards and tiles, and verifying logged-in states. The class contains workaround code for alpha testing with Windows dummy printers.
